comingLast.roast: off 30 and blue - the friendliest wooden spoon in the field
3 holes of runway left - 6 points clears the fence
the good news: 3 points saves him. the bad news: current form says 1.2 a hole
on 19 - the escape committee (his foursome) has convened
on 16, needs 6 - somebody radio ahead to the bar
on 13 - the two blue balls have begun their lap of honour early
4 holes left to avoid the double blue - 5 points does it
escape number: 5. holes remaining: 4. belief in the clubhouse: modest.
on 15 - the leaderboard reads top to bottom, everyone reads bottom first today
current pace 1.3 a hole - the engraver is hovering
